title: Query Pod Exit Codes
description: Aggregate exit codes ACROSS ALL PODS of a multi-pod workload via the Python native API (`triage_workloads_api.py`) to identify the non-zero primary failure. Use this for a cross-pod tally; for exit codes in surrounding log context within a single workload, use [[query-exit-codes]] instead.

workload_name.description: The name prefix of the workload or jobset.
